title: IIIF Text Granularity Annotation Extension
description: Derived from the IIIF Text Granularity Extension prose and context. It validates the extension property only; the containing Annotation remains subject to the IIIF Presentation API and Web Annotation contracts.
$comment: The specification requires a single string. The six values in the IIIF context are recommendations rather than an exhaustive MUST-level enum because registered extensions may define additional values.
